name: Arcade Island X: Working Arcade 🌴
desc:
🌴 Play arcade games, win tickets, collect prizes, and explore the island in an awesome extravaganza! New claw machines!

🕹️ Play arcade games and win tickets!
🎫 Win tickets and unlock prizes!
🏝️ Roleplay on the island!
🧸 Plus, new claw machines! Win prizes from the claw machines!

🎉 Inspired by arcades, fun centers, and theme parks like Dave and Buster’s, Round1, Main Event, Chuck E Cheese, Six Flags, Universal Studios, and Disneyland!

Arcade Island was built to share the fun of arcade games with the world. We are committed to fair and transparent fun, and staying in compliance with all Roblox rules. Learn more at https://devforum.roblox.com/t/01443134.
